desc:
Train your strength, beat the guards, and pull the legendary swords from their stones!

💪 TRAIN on dummies to grow stronger, and pop bonus bubbles for huge strength boosts!
🗡️ PULL 40 legendary swords, from Wood all the way to Celestial
🛡️ FIGHT guard armies and epic bosses in every zone
🎲 ROLL for allies and armor sets, from Common up to the 0.001% SUPER SECRET!
🌳 UPGRADE your skill tree, then dash, block and parry your way through
🕳️ ENDLESS mode: team up with friends and see how deep the cave goes
👑 WORLD BOSS fights with the whole server
🧪 Potions, daily rewards, quests and leaderboards

Can you lift the Celestial Sword? 👀
